disclosureQuote: All voice acting is performed by professional actors and is licensed. All the music in the game was composed by real composers—Ilya Khaminov, Sergey Sergeev, Alexander Kosyakov, and Emil Zenko—and is licensed. All 3D models and animations were created by our talented team of professional artists. As part of the development process, generative AI was used to assist in the creation of certain visual elements, including artistic textures and company logos. The AI-generated content was reviewed, edited, and/or further refined by our development team before being incorporated into the game. The game has been in development since 2019, and 99% of all game content was created by professional developers, artists, and designers.
summary: 月球殖民与自动化工厂模拟。开发者披露配音、音乐与 3D 模型由专业人员完成，生成式 AI 用于辅助部分视觉元素（艺术贴图、公司 logo），产出经人工复核后使用。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 完整披露、身份与英文界面讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 286），首页无与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。逐款检索公开报道 3 次、登记 15 条结果，没有一条与本作的 AI 使用相关，因此判断只依据商店披露与讨论区首页。讨论区仅覆盖首页，检索非穷尽。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 官方披露把生成式 AI 限定在部分视觉元素，并声明配音与音乐由职业演员和真人作曲完成。

english.summary: A lunar colony and factory sim. The developer states that voice acting, music and 3D models are made by professionals, while generative AI assisted certain visual elements such as artistic textures and company logos, reviewed by the team before use.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full Steam disclosure, identity and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 286); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. Coverage was searched three times for this game with 15 results and none was a readable article about this title, so the finding rests on the store disclosure and the discussion homepage alone. Discussion coverage is limited to the homepage and search is not exhaustive. Findings rely on developer statements, not an independent audit.
